text:
Priya: Quick async standup — short updates. What I did / blockers / today:

Maya: Did the KV warmup tuning overnight and instrumented embed worker logs. Saw p95 embed latency jump in eu-west around 03:08–03:15 UTC (spike to ~2.1s).

PagerBot: alert: embed-latency-eu-west p95 > 1.8s — fired 2025-03-18T03:12:00Z

Alex: I'm oncall; I looked at the autoscaler metrics. Batcher was flapping because short bursts dropped to zero and then spiked. Rolled a temporary cooldown change to reduce churn, monitoring now.

Dan: Autoscaler behavior looked noisy. Increased stabilization window to 60s on staging to observe. Patch applied with command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa batcher --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":60}}}'
```
Will push same to prod once we validate.

Priya: FYI PR #432 needs review — small kv prefetch change that should help cold starts (https://github.com/redwood/pr/432). @Samir can you take a look today?

Samir: On it, I'll review after standup. Also noticed a small uptick in 504s from reranker around the same window — tracing points to an upstream timeout. Leaving a comment with traces.

Alex: The 504s matched CPU saturation on the fallback fleet. Increased CPU request for reranker replicas and kicked a canary redeploy. DeployBot: started canary for reranker-v3 (5% traffic).

DeployBot: Canary deploy for reranker-v3 started at 2025-03-18T03:40:12Z — route 5% -> canary

Maya: After the autoscaler tweak and the small CPU bump, eu-west p95 back down to ~1.1s and errors trending down. Still above our 1.0s goal but improving. I'll keep charting for the next 2 hours. :eyes:

Priya: Blockers: need short runbook blurb for oncall steps on embed-latency (what to check first, quick mitigations). I can write docs but need a few lines from eng-sre for the action steps. Also small docs update for paging thresholds.

Dan: I can draft the runbook snippet and drop it in the docs repo by EOD. Will include commands to inspect HPA, KV cache hit rates, and the reranker fallback route.

Samir: Leaving review comments on PR #432. Quick ping if anyone wants me to pair-review. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks team — appreciate the fast triage. I'll post a short summary to #incidents if the trend reverses, otherwise we'll close the ticket after 24h of stable metrics. :heart:
